intent: Code-only bundle fixes for a Webflow hotel site's mobile feedback: stop scroll jumps on FAQ toggle and near the footer, sticky Reserve-a-table CTA visible on first load and hiding at Other dining options, hero image scale-in and restored room-gallery scale+fade, extended scroll reveals (FAQ rows, fade-only RFP fields and mobile Home collage, Corporate images on mobile), animated mobile subnav dropdown, keyboard-only focus rings, script tilt spacing on phones, Directions links in a new tab. Reduced motion instant; keyboard and screen reader behaviour must not regress. Spec: /home/sanindo/guild-hotel-webflow-build-228-spec-mobile-feedback-code-fixes-builder/docs/builds/228/issue.md

findings.title: fade-only hides form fields and FAQ rows from keyboard and AT
findings.suggested_fix: For fade-only on interactive rows (form fields, FAQ items) animate opacity only (gsap.fromTo with opacity, not autoAlpha), or reveal an element on its focusin as well as on scroll. Assumption: pure opacity fade is acceptable visually.
findings.why_it_matters: playFadeOnly animates autoAlpha from 0, so every tagged contact/RFP field and FAQ row is visibility:hidden until its scroll trigger fires. Hidden controls are not focusable and are skipped by Tab and screen readers, so a keyboard user tabbing into the form from above skips fields below the 90% line and lands past them, contradicting the 'keyboard/screen-reader behaviour must not regress' constraint.
evidence: src/utils/scrollReveal.ts:413-417 -- gsap.fromTo(element, { autoAlpha: 0 }, { autoAlpha: 1, ..., scrollTrigger: { trigger: element, start, once: true } })
findings.validation_reason: scrollReveal.ts:214 uses autoAlpha:0 in a fromTo (immediateRender), which sets visibility:hidden on the tagged .form-split-script-contact_field and .accordion_item rows (lines 139-141) until the once-only ScrollTrigger fires, and visibility:hidden elements are not focusable; incidence in a real keyboard session was not measured.

findings.title: Interrupted tab dropdown timeline still fires onComplete
findings.suggested_fix: Store the active timeline (let active: gsap.core.Timeline | undefined), call active?.kill() at the start of setOpen before killTweensOf, and assign each new timeline to it. Add a Playwright case that clicks the toggle twice within 200ms and asserts the panel ends open with visible links.
findings.why_it_matters: Tapping the toggle again while a close (or open) is mid-flight kills the child tweens with gsap.killTweensOf, but the parent timeline survives as an empty timeline and fires its onComplete on the next tick. A reopen during close then gets is-open and is-closing stripped and inline styles cleared a frame after the new open timeline started, so the list collapses or flashes while aria-expanded says open. Keep the timeline in a variable and kill it (not just its tweens) at the top of setOpen.
findings.validation_reason: setOpen only calls gsap.killTweensOf(animated) (line 125) and never kills the parent timelines built at lines 147 and 167, and per GSAP 3.13 semantics (CDN global, not inspected locally) an interrupted timeline still completes and fires onComplete, so a close timeline's onComplete (lines 169-172) can strip OPEN_CLASS and clear inline styles after a reopen has started; incidence not measured.

learnings.title: GSAP module conventions
learnings.note: Honoured (autoAlpha, no inline display, once triggers); focusRing inline outline:none is a minor adjacent concern.

learnings.title: Page-load scroll freeze
learnings.note: heroImageScale starts a 1.8s time-based tween at Webflow.push; on slow loads the scale-in may finish before paint.

learnings.title: ScrollTrigger stale positions from late image loads
learnings.note: Honoured; new mobile reveal targets (Corporate, Home collage) should carry data-eager when added in Webflow.

residual_risks: tabDropdown: gsap.killTweensOf(animated) on a close timeline may let that timeline's onComplete (removes is-open, clearInline) still fire during a fast reopen; not verifiable without gsap runtime here.
focusRing sets inline outline:none on mouse-focused text inputs, removing the focus indicator for mouse users; depends on the site's own field focus styling.
stickyCta belowFold start of -1 relies on ScrollTrigger treating progress just above 0 as active at scroll 0; covered only by the visual fixture, not run here.

Playwright fixtures load GSAP 3.13.0 from jsDelivr while docs reference GSAP 3.15.0 for the live site; transform/translate handling in stickyCta (CSS translate plus GSAP yPercent from the hero mask) is only proven against 3.13.0 in a hand-built fixture, not the real Webflow hero markup.

Fixtures are synthetic HTML: class names and the Corporate/Home collage selectors (feature-grid-dark-eyebrow_item-figure, home-art-stories_trail-figure) are assumptions that never match anything in fixtures against real Webflow DOM; mobile reveals could silently do nothing live while specs pass.
directionsLinks runs once at load and overwrites rel; CMS items injected later (Finsweet load-more) are not covered, and any existing rel (e.g. nofollow) is dropped.
heroImageScale clearProps:'transform' on the hero image would wipe any transform another module sets on the same element; none found by grep in src.
GSAP not installed in checkout, so the empty-timeline onComplete behaviour was reasoned from GSAP semantics, not run.
Desktop stickyCta settle tween (gsap.to(tween ...)) is not killed on overlapping toggles or undock, so a fast scroll across half a screen can leave two tweens writing bottom; low impact.

src/utils/tabDropdown.ts extends its bundle-injected STYLES string (is-closing selectors, overflow:hidden). CLAUDE.md says custom CSS goes in an HTML embed, never bundle CSS; the injected stylesheet predates this diff, so not flagged as a new violation.

tabDropdown interruption paths (reopen during the close tween via the wasOpen branch, close during open) are untested; killTweensOf plus partial inline styles could leave odd heights, but no test drives rapid toggling.
stickyCta default path (dockFromLoad off, used by the Story Learn more button) and the desktop settle tween rewritten to setBottom have no assertions; only the dockFromLoad hero case is covered.
All new visual specs except mobile-code-fixes-235 load GSAP/Lenis from jsDelivr, so they fail offline and are not wired into test:factory.

src/utils/focusRing.ts:183 Keyboard user tabbing in from browser chrome gets no ring on first stop (adversarial, P2): In the focusin handler, skip quieting when target.matches(':focus-visible') and the last input was not a pointer; only quiet on a pointer-initiated focus or tabindex=-1 targets. Assumption: modern browsers' :focus-visible already hides the ring for mouse and script focus on buttons and links.

src/utils/map.ts:88 Redundant openInNewTab call and cross-module import in map.ts (maintainability, P3): Remove the openInNewTab import and the call in map.ts; keep directionsLinks as the single owner (then openInNewTab need not be exported).
testing_gaps: No test for toggling tabDropdown closed then open again within the 0.5s close window.
No spec covers keyboard Tab traversal through reveal-hidden FAQ rows/form fields, or a focus entry that does not originate from an in-page keydown.
tab-dropdown spec has no rapid double-toggle (close then reopen within the 0.3s close) case.

src/utils/scrollReveal.ts:180 Room-page gallery restore and Corporate mobile image-fade have no test (testing, P2): Extend scroll-reveal-fade-only.html with a room-description marker plus a .gallery-mosaic-captioned_figure (assert data-reveal=image-fade and opacity 0 then 1), and a .feature-grid-dark-eyebrow_item figure at 390px (assert it fades in and the media transform is cleared), plus a desktop case asserting it is left alone.

tests/visual/fixtures/mobile-code-fixes-235.html:1590 Directions test cannot tell which selector matched (testing, P3): Give the cms-dir fixture link href="#" with only data-map-directions, and add a separate link with only a google.com/maps/dir href lacking destination=.

tests/visual/tab-dropdown.spec.ts:104 Outside-click close assertion in tab dropdown test is vacuous (testing, P3): Add a test that opens the dropdown, clicks [data-fixture=after], and asserts aria-expanded=false and that is-open is removed after the close tween.
